input.notes:
While at university I worked part time at an escape room where our team built a new room over the summer.
We ran test sessions with staff and friends before the room opened, and logged where each group got stuck and how long they took.
The average test time came down from 74 minutes to 58 after the team changed two clues.
I learned that if three groups get stuck on the same clue, the clue is wrong, not the groups.
Puzzlebox Rooms is where I'd like to keep working because the owners rebuild a weak puzzle rather than hint their way round it.
